text:
QUOTE: "An `index_scope:` section in `.clew.yaml` with at least one existing `roots:` entry replaces the whole-repo scope. `excludes` alone is rejected. Unknown keys are rejected too, and a rejected declaration falls back to the whole repo with a logged warning"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared index_scope takes precedence, and that a rejected declaration or an absent one falls back to the whole repo. This covers the preference and the fall-through, though it names only some failure modes.
